status: Analytic CAD-derived clearance cores; source/plate transforms derived from actual print export lineage. Partial coverage, no printability certification.
containment_rule: Map point through inverse(local_to_source_print_matrix) or inverse(local_to_plate_matrix); box inclusive min/max or cylinder x*x+y*y<=radius_mm**2 and z in z_mm. These are oriented true volumes; bounds_* are broad-phase only.
scope: 34 cassette PCB/component channels and leaf reliefs
34 magnet cartridges side-entry and magnet/M2 cavities
16 integrated hinge-parent frames M3 nut/washer access
Magnet cap source meshes use inherited export datums: central through-hole and two M2 bore centers recovered by exact source vertex circle fit, not current assembly transform.
limitations: Not all screw head pockets, cable-tie slots, side reliefs, core-lightening cavities or all removal corridors are encoded.
Core cylinders inside hex nuts protect the inscribed region only, not all hex corners.
Volumes conservatively inset by0.05..0.125mm; passing a path test is not a full void-clearance proof.
Large open assembly spaces must remain eligible for tree support if removable through their broad opening. Do not globally forbid every face with model below.
Swept extrusion width must be considered, not only G-code centerlines.
Direct per-instance source coordinate mapping is tied to the current source3MF and current A1mini transforms; regenerate if orientation changes.
